goal: Add (A) live side-by-side iframe preview in the admin content editor and (B) draft/publish workflow with an admin-only /preview route. Edits save as drafts; public site shows published values until explicit Publish.
stack: TypeScript, Next.js 15 App Router, Prisma 6 + Supabase Postgres, Tailwind v4 + custom CSS (globals.css), NextAuth v5 credentials (single admin), Zod. Do NOT change stack.
flow: Schema migration first, then shared HomepageView server component, then draft data layer + /preview route + actions refactor, then admin content page live-preview panel. Each step verified with next build before moving on.
constraints: Public '/' must never leak drafts — only Publish revalidates '/'. Draft saves revalidate only /preview and /admin/content.
keep HomepageView a SERVER component (no client state) to avoid hydration issues; force-dynamic + noStore already in play
do NOT weaken global CSP; only relax frame-ancestors for /preview per-route if browser self-embed is blocked
postMessage is the chosen live-preview transport (same-origin iframe); do not switch to polling/URL-params
preserve the mediaAsset.upsert IMAGE logic from the current saveContentAction into publishContentAction
